env TARGET=$WORK/.cursor/skills
env SRC=$WORK/source

# Register source and try to install skill_a (which exists on disk but is untracked)
exec axen source add $SRC
exec axen install source --all --targets=cursor

# Default behavior: it should warn/prompt and select "Skip all" in MockPrompter, keeping manual files and NOT installing the new skill files
exists $TARGET/skill_a/manual.txt
! exists $TARGET/skill_a/SKILL.md

# Verify output mentions the warning and suggests --force command
stdout 'Warning: The following skill\(s\) already exist'
stdout 'axen install source --force'

# Now force install skill_a
exec axen install source --all --targets=cursor --force

# Under --force, it should overwrite the directory, deleting manual files and installing the new skill files
! exists $TARGET/skill_a/manual.txt
exists $TARGET/skill_a/SKILL.md

-- .cursor/skills/skill_a/manual.txt --
pre-existing
-- source/skill_a/SKILL.md --
name: skill_a
-- source/axen.json --
{"axen_version": "1", "name": "mysrc", "skills":{"skill_a":{"path":"skill_a"}}}
